recent_posts.title: Building a CLI with Quarkus, Kotlin and GraalVM · Maarten on IT
recent_posts.summary: A comprehensive guide to building command-line applications using Quarkus, Kotlin, and GraalVM. The tutorial covers project setup with Maven, integrating Kotlin compiler plugins, adding PicoCLI for command parsing, implementing subcommands with dependency injection, and compiling to native executables for fast startup times. Includes practical examples of argument handling, configuration management, and development workflow optimization.

recent_posts.title: Coding, Thinking and Adapting: My Take-Aways from Devoxx Poland 2025 · Maarten on IT
recent_posts.summary: Conference takeaways from Devoxx Poland 2025 covering mutation testing with PITest for better test quality validation, practical applications of monads for cleaner code, lessons learned from running Quarkus in production for three years, the evolving role of AI and LLMs in software development with critical perspectives on their limitations, and hexagonal architecture implementation through live coding demonstrations.

recent_posts.title: Authenticate Jakarta EE apps with Google using OpenID Connect · Maarten on IT
recent_posts.summary: The post provides a detailed guide on how to authenticate Jakarta EE applications with Google using OpenID Connect. It explains the configuration of OpenID Connect Annotation, how to externalize configuration using Jakarta Expression Language, protecting application resources, assigning roles to users, and handling logout functionality.

recent_posts.title: Reduce Maven Plugin logging · Maarten on IT
recent_posts.summary: When using a Maven plugin like the OpenAPI Generator, excessive logging can make it difficult for developers to focus on actual problems. For a plugin that generated over 22000 lines of non-critical output, reducing this noise was crucial. Solutions involve configuring the Simple Logging Facade for Java (SLF4J) by setting system properties, achieving a significant reduction in unnecessary logs.

recent_posts.title: Devnexus 2024 · Maarten on IT
recent_posts.summary: The Devnexus 2024 blog post highlights sessions on software architecture, Apache Maven 4, and knowledge management. It discusses the factors that influence the granularity of services in a microservices architecture, tools to assess software architecture quality, and the importance of knowledge management in software development.

recent_posts.title: Measure Your Maven Build · Maarten on IT
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to measure the performance of your Maven build and identify bottlenecks. Explore different tools like Maven Profiler, Maven BuildTime Profiler, and Maven OpenTelemetry extension.

recent_posts.title: Why Write Boring Apps? · Maarten on IT
recent_posts.summary: The post discusses the drawbacks of building single-page applications and highlights the importance of simplicity in web development. It covers issues such as loading time, search engine optimization, accessibility, security, and graceful degradation. The author suggests that not every application needs to be a full-blown SPA and provides examples of 'boring applications' that can be implemented with simpler approaches.

top_posts.title: Playing with Loom · Maarten on IT
top_posts.summary: Project Loom is aimed at delivering lightweight concurrency for the Java platform through JVM features and APIs. It introduces the concept of virtual threads, which do not map one-to-one to OS threads and are managed by the JVM for better hardware utilization. The post explores the advantages of virtual threading over conventional threading and provides code examples.
